consulting.headline: SKIMSTONES offers various services dedicated to energy transition players
consulting.pageTitle: SKIMSTONES structures, secures and deploys complex energy transition and circular economy projects
consulting.intro1: SKIMSTONES supports industrials, local authorities, operators and investors in transforming technical, energy or environmental constraints into robust, manageable and fundable projects.
consulting.intro2: We operate where the stakes are complex: critical systems, difficult waste streams, fragmented value chains, emerging technologies, business models yet to be built.

posture.label: OUR POSTURE
posture.title: An independent, rigorous and decision-driven partner.
posture.desc: SKIMSTONES does not sell a standard technology. We help understand the problem, qualify the risks, structure the options, align the stakeholders and secure the next decisions.

pillars.label: OUR TWO PILLARS
pillars.title: Industrial process and systems architecture.
pillars.desc: Our added value is based on a dual perspective: understanding how installations, flows and processes actually work, while analysing dependencies, interfaces and economic feasibility conditions.

expertises.label: 4 EXPERTISES, 1 INNOVATION
expertises.intro: SKIMSTONES deploys a cross-functional industrial approach in service of performance, resilience and the responsible transformation of energy and industrial systems.

spof.label: CRITICAL RESILIENCE
spof.sublabel: SPOF - SINGLE POINT OF FAILURE DETECTION
spof.desc: Identifying the invisible fragilities that can compromise the continuity of an installation, network or critical service. SKIMSTONES maps dependencies, analyses real redundancies, prioritises risks and builds a concrete action plan to strengthen operational resilience.
spof.pageSubtitle: Because a single weak point can bring an entire system to a halt
spof.hero1: Power plants, thermal networks and critical infrastructures rely on complex functional chains. An unidentified failure can affect production, distribution, critical customers and service continuity.
spof.hero2: SKIMSTONES identifies, prioritises and secures single points of failure before they become shutdowns, financial losses or operational crises.
spof.positioning: A systemic approach, focused on decision and resilience
spof.positioningDesc: Our method goes beyond visible equipment. It also analyses interfaces, support systems, functional dependencies, degraded modes and gaps between documentation and field reality.
spof.acc1Short: Plant, network, critical interfaces, support systems and operational realities.
spof.acc1Long:
SKIMSTONES analyses the entire service continuity chain: production units, heat or cold networks, coupling interfaces, supervision, auxiliary power, cooling, instrumentation air, telecommunications, procedures and operator skills.

The objective is to identify vulnerabilities that do not always emerge in classic equipment-by-equipment analyses.
spof.acc2Short: A dual expertise: industrial process and systems architecture.
spof.acc2Long:
Our approach combines an understanding of real installations, flows and operational constraints with a cross-sectional reading of effective dependencies, interfaces and redundancies.

This dual perspective reveals invisible fragilities: those located between equipment, within functional chains or in real post-incident recovery conditions.
spof.acc3Short: A structured method to move from data to decision.
spof.acc3Intro: The SPOF approach progresses in stages:
spof.acc3Step4Key: construction of a costed action plan
spof.acc3ConclRest: : scenarios are validated with operations and engineering teams.
spof.acc4Short: A SPOF register, mappings, prioritisation and an action plan.
spof.acc4Item5Rest: after incidents, modifications or periodic reviews.
spof.acc4Concl1: The goal is not only to detect vulnerabilities, but to
spof.mod1Desc: A targeted first read of a critical perimeter to identify major SPOFs and first priority actions.
spof.mod2Desc: Full deployment of the method: mapping, SPOF register, scoring, action plan and economic justification.
spof.mod3Desc: Register updates, periodic reviews, flash audits and priority refreshes.
spof.mod4Desc: Method adoption, skills development and integration of resilience management into operational practices.
spof.ctaTitle: You cannot secure what you cannot yet see.
spof.ctaDesc: SKIMSTONES helps operators identify critical fragilities, prioritise useful actions and durably strengthen their service continuity.

wvc.label: CIRCULAR VALUE CHAIN
wvc.desc: Transforming constrained waste streams into value-creating industrial projects. SKIMSTONES analyses flows, compares technological pathways, structures the business model, secures outlets and prepares investment decisions for realistic and fundable recovery projects.

woil.label: STRATEGIC SECTOR
woil.desc: Structuring a local used oil regeneration sector with high added value. From collection to final outlet, SKIMSTONES helps qualify the resource, organise partners, build the industrial model and prepare a credible deployment trajectory.
woil.pageSubtitle: Used oil is not waste. It is a raw material.
woil.intro: SKIMSTONES deploys, in technological partnership, next-generation re-refining platforms that restore virgin lubricants from industrial and automotive used oils.
woil.techSubtitle: A technological breakthrough compared to conventional processes
woil.techDesc: Multi-stage re-refining through successive physical separations, without hydro-treatment, without costly catalysts, without harmful emissions.
woil.card1Desc: Motor, hydraulic, industrial and transmission oils. Any industrial or automotive source.
woil.card2Desc: Successive physical separations. No hydro-treatment. No harmful emissions. No costly catalysts.
woil.card3Desc: Grade I base oil, low-sulphur fuel oil, recoverable residues. Virgin quality guaranteed.
woil.advantageDesc: Used oil can be re-refined indefinitely without losing its lubricating properties. Unlike combustion, re-refining fully preserves the value of the resource.
woil.productsSubtitle: Every litre entering the treatment unit comes out recovered
woil.prod1Desc: Virgin quality, compliant with industrial and automotive standards. Ready for direct reuse in industrial circuits, construction equipment, vehicle fleets and transport.
woil.prod2Desc: Low-sulphur fuel oil, recoverable as industrial fuel. Compliant with quality requirements for industrial burners and boilers.
woil.prod3Desc: Sulphur ash and residues recoverable as road sub-base and agricultural amendments. No residue in uncontrolled landfill.
woil.stat1Desc: of used oil processed per year per unit
woil.stat2Desc: of collected oil restored as Grade I virgin lubricant
woil.stat3Desc: CO₂ emissions vs. virgin lubricant production
woil.stat4Desc: of CO₂ avoided annually per treatment unit
woil.roleDesc: SKIMSTONES takes full responsibility for the entire project cycle — from feasibility to operational commissioning.
woil.role1Desc: Techno-economic feasibility study, process engineering, unit sizing based on locally available used oil resources.
woil.role2Desc: As EPC Manager with our Technology Partner, SKIMSTONES delivers a unit that runs — not just equipment. From the first stone laid to the first litre of oil produced.
woil.role3Desc: SKIMSTONES is a SPOF (Single Point of Failure) expert. Each treatment unit is designed to eliminate critical failure points and guarantee operational continuity.
woil.quote: « Used oil can be re-refined indefinitely without losing its lubricating properties. This is the very example of a truly circular circular economy. »
woil.ctaText: Are you an industrialist, fleet manager, local authority or investor?
woil.perfNote: delivers documented industrial performance and quantified environmental impact.

pm.label: ALTERNATIVE ENERGIES
pm.desc: Taking an energy project from concept to execution. SKIMSTONES supports project owners in scoping, technology selection, supplier consultation, study management, stakeholder coordination and follow-up through to commissioning.

sqweezy.label: OUR PRODUCT
sqweezy.desc: Compacting bottles and cans at source, simply, without energy. SQWEEZY is the domestic compactor developed by SKIMSTONES to improve sorting habits, reduce collected volumes, limit transported air and reinforce the efficiency of selective collection systems.

founders.headline: Meet Skimstones' founders
founders.missionText: Because waste is a resource, SKIMSTONES exists to transform what is too often seen as a constraint into real, measurable value. We structure, de-risk and coordinate waste treatment and recovery projects, actively contributing to the energy transition — through realistic, fundable and scalable solutions for industrial players across the globe.
founders.visionText: SKIMSTONES aspires to become the global reference for waste recovery and fossil energy substitution solutions — building a world where nothing is wasted, and everything is transformed.
founders.valuesText: Like a stone skipping on water, at SKIMSTONES we believe a single positive action can set off a chain of ripples. Solidarity, systemic thinking, hard work and a sense of humour fuel our momentum.
